{'text': '一部 Apple-1 電腦在拍賣會上以 1,148,200 美元成交，創下新紀錄。這部電腦上一次於 2013 年出售時，售價為 686,000 美元。它隨機附有一封信，而原機主幸好冇理會封信……', 'paragraph_context': 'An Apple-1 computer sold at auction has set a new record of $1,148,200. The same machine last sold in 2013 for $686,000. It comes complete with a letter which, thankfully, the original owner ignored …'}

{'text': '呢部機被稱為「Hatfield」Apple-1，以原機主 Fred Hatfield 嘅名字命名。主機板有 Steve Wozniak 嘅簽名，並附有一封由 Steve Jobs 簽名嘅信件。', 'paragraph_context': 'The machine is known as the “Hatfield” Apple-1, after the name of the original owner, Fred Hatfield. The motherboard was signed by Steve Wozniak, and it came with a letter signed by Steve Jobs.'}

{'text': 'Hatfield 好彩拒絕咗封信入面嘅提議，即係用呢部機換取一部 Apple II。Hatfield 因為唔滿意部機嘅軟件選擇有限而寫信畀 Apple，Steve 之後就提出呢個換機方案。', 'paragraph_context': 'Thankfully for Hatfield, he rejected the offer made in that letter, which was to trade in the machine for an Apple II. Steve made the offer after Hatfield wrote to Apple complaining about the limited software options for the machine.'}

{'text': '呢部機能夠完全運作，而且可以追溯到原本嘅買家，大幅增加咗佢嘅吸引力；但相比 2013 年嘅成交價，今次嘅增幅顯示佢哋嘅價值持續上升。', 'paragraph_context': 'The fact that the machine is in full working order and can be traced back to its original purchaser added significant appeal, but the increase over the price achieved back in 2013 points to their continuing appreciating value.'}

{'text': 'Hatfield Apple-1 由 Bonhams 透過網上拍賣售出。', 'paragraph_context': 'The Hatfield Apple-1 sold in an online auction by Bonhams.'}
